吴姜和赵安坤坐上飞往深市的客机上，旁边坐着的是李强。

吴姜也没想到，王雅琴这次这么爽快就同意他出来了，他只是说帮同学的忙，介绍一位师傅去给他同学表哥的公司看个风水。

飞机平稳降落在深市机场，刚走出机舱，一股湿热的暖风就扑面而来，和绿城的寒凉截然不同。

“好家伙，这深市也太热了！”赵安坤忍不住扯了扯身上的厚外套，额角已经冒出了细密的汗珠。

李强连忙说道：“赵叔，咱们先去卫生间换一下衣服吧，到了外面会更热的。”

赵安坤点了点头，跟着李强往卫生间走去。

吴姜一个人在外面等着，吹着轻快的口哨，双手插在口袋里，一脸悠闲。

他早有先见之明，从家里出来时，里面就穿了一件薄款单衣，现在只需要将外套塞进包里就行了。

没等几分钟，赵安坤和李强就换好衣服走了出来，三人一同往机场外走去。

李强给他表哥打了一个电话，挂了没一会儿，一个面容有些憔悴，带着副宽边眼镜，看着有三十多岁的人出现在了他们面前。

李强赶忙迎了上去，笑着介绍：“哥，我来给你介绍一下，这位就是赵师傅，这位是我的同学吴姜。”

说完，他又转头对着赵安坤和吴姜说道：“赵师傅，吴姜，这位就是我的表哥刘航。”

刘航连忙伸出手，紧紧握住赵安坤的大手。

“赵师傅，辛苦您大老远跑一趟，真是太麻烦您了！”

赵安坤轻轻和他握了握，语气平淡：“刘老板客气了，既然来了，就会尽力帮你看看，先别着急，凡事都有解决的办法。”

刘航又和吴姜握了握手，顺势表达了感谢。

“哥，我们先走吧，有什么事到了车上再说！”李强适时提醒道。

“对对对，请跟我来，车在那边停着。”

Wu Jiang and Zhao Ankun got on the passenger plane flying to Shenzhen City, and sitting next to them was Li Qiang.

Wu Jiang also didn't expect that Wang Yaqin would agree to come out so readily this time. He just said that he would do a favor to his classmate and introduce a master to do Feng Shui for his classmate's cousin's company.

The plane landed smoothly at Shenzhen Airport. As soon as I stepped out of the cabin, a warm and humid wind hit my face, which was completely different from the coldness of Green City.

"Good guy, it's too hot in this deep city!" Zhao Ankun couldn't help but tugged on his thick coat, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.

Li Qiang said quickly: "Uncle Zhao, let's go to the bathroom and change clothes first. It will be hotter outside."

Zhao Ankun nodded and followed Li Qiang to the bathroom.

Wu Jiang was waiting outside alone, whistling briskly, with his hands in his pockets and a leisurely expression.

He had already had the foresight to wear a thin singlet when he came out of the house, and now he only needed to stuff his jacket into his bag.

Within a few minutes, Zhao Ankun and Li Qiang changed their clothes and walked out, and the three of them walked out of the airport together.

Li Qiang called his cousin. After hanging up for a while, a man in his thirties appeared in front of them with a haggard face and wide-rimmed glasses.

Li Qiang hurriedly greeted him and introduced with a smile: "Brother, let me introduce you. This is Master Zhao, and this is my classmate Wu Jiang."

After saying that, he turned to Zhao Ankun and Wu Jiang and said, "Master Zhao, Wu Jiang, this is my cousin Liu Hang."

Liu Hang quickly reached out and held Zhao Ankun's big hand tightly.

"Master Zhao, it's really troublesome for you to go all the way!"

Zhao Ankun shook hands with him gently and said in a calm tone: "Boss Liu, you're welcome. Now that I'm here, I will try my best to help you. Don't worry, there is a solution to everything."

Liu Hang shook hands with Wu Jiang again and expressed his gratitude.

"Brother, let's go first. If anything happens, we'll talk about it in the car!" Li Qiang reminded him at the right time.

"Yes, yes, please come with me. The car is parked over there."
